$comment: D7 activity_join offer acceptance: the queue control lease signs the acceptance, the server validates the still-current offer plus membership/proximity, then rotates to a play lease. No other action value is accepted on activity_join.
name: join-accept-offer
invariants: acceptance uses the queue control lease, not a play input lease
offer must still exist and be unexpired (queueOfferWindowSeconds)
rotated play lease invalidates the queue lease for future commands
first accepted input seq after rotation is 1
